sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Bukijutsu Water Release, Lightning Release, Storm Branch

system.description:
While covered in lightning, you dash forward towards a creature like a bolt of lightning, generating enough momentum to cause a clap of thunder after you strike. Move into a space next to a creature you can reach with your Movement speed, then make a melee Taijutsu (or Ninjutsu) attack against them, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] or [Weapon Damage] + 5d12 lightning damage as you clothes line them, forcing them to make a Strength saving throw, being Dazed and knocked Prone on a failure. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is also Bruised.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d12.
